attribution_methodology.rule: One mutant may affect multiple capabilities; all affected capabilities are recorded. If attribution cannot be established, UNMAPPED_CAPABILITY is emitted.

attributions.behavioral_hypothesis: Mutant survives because fee calculation logic is ambiguous; tests pin current behavior
attributions.reason: Design/contract question: unclear whether fee should be based on closest-to-225-bps or current arithmetic. Human authorization required for production fix.
